weak_findings.reason: Stored-XSS-via-memos path is overstated: server.js sets marked.setOptions({sanitize:true}) (line 127), which in marked 0.3.5 strips raw HTML/script from memo markdown before render in memos.html ({{ marked(doc.memo) }}). The finding's own 'existing mitigations' and remediation both keep sanitize:true, yet the attack path still asserts script 'executes in every viewer's session' and rates CRITICAL. With the active sanitizer the script-execution path does not cleanly follow; the cross-user-info-leak portion (covered separately by TM-022) is the defensible part. Severity/path inflated.

Named sink does not follow from the template. Finding says displayProfile's HTML-encoded doc.website is 'rendered both as an input value and inside an href link.' In app/views/profile.html the website is only in an input value attribute ({{website}}, line 70); the href (line 78) is wired to {{firstNameSafeString}} (firstName), not website. The wrong-context-encoding javascript:-URL-in-href narrative actually applies to firstName, not the website field. A real reflected XSS via website (unescaped attribute value, autoescape off) exists, but the specific attack path as written is mis-wired to the wrong field/sink.

notes: Verified all 22 findings against source under /tmp/eval_targets/nodegoat; judged a 15-finding sample spanning CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM. 13/15 sound. Confirmed against real code: TM-001 eval() of req.body.preTax/afterTax/roth before validation (app/routes/contributions.js:32-34); TM-002 unescaped $where this.stocks > '${threshold}' (app/data/allocations-dao.js:77-79); TM-003 needle.get(req.query.url + req.query.symbol) with reflected body (app/routes/research.js:15-27); TM-004 cleartext password store + === compare, bcrypt commented out (app/data/user-dao.js:25-30,60-66); TM-005 ssn/dob/bankAcc/bankRouting stored cleartext, crypto helpers commented out (app/data/profile-dao.js:42-92); TM-006 userId from req.params not session (app/routes/allocations.js:16-23); TM-008 isAdmin commented out on /benefits (app/routes/index.js:55-60); TM-009 cookieSecret/cryptoKey hardcoded (config/env/all.js:8-9), secret used at server.js:82; TM-010 committed RSA private key (artifacts/cert/server.key); TM-011 res.redirect(req.query.url) (app/routes/index.js:70-73); TM-013 http.createServer, helmet/csurf commented out (server.js:12,145); TM-015 regex /([0-9]+)+\#/ nested quantifier (app/routes/profile.js:59); TM-018 admin/Admin_123 seeded cleartext (artifacts/db-reset.js:12-37); TM-019 marked 0.3.5/mongodb 2.x/swig 1.4.2/needle 2.2.4/node:12-alpine confirmed (package.json, Dockerfile:1); TM-022 getAllMemos find({}) no owner filter (app/data/memos-dao.js:26-35). Two weak findings flagged above. Two minor (non-disqualifying) sub-claims: TM-009's 'cryptoKey-encrypted data recoverable' is moot since the encrypt/decrypt helpers are commented out (cryptoKey is unused at runtime) — but the session-cookie-forgery path is fully sound, so TM-009 stays sound overall. TM-012's session-fixation claim is correct for login (no req.session.regenerate at session.js:116) even though handleSignup does regenerate (session.js:234). Proportionality: 22 findings on a deliberately-vulnerable app of ~21 real components; every finding maps to a real file, no invented components, no speculative padding, and no_issue_surface correctly lists the static tutorial router (C10), counters (D5), logout (E3). Proportionate.
